殿内一片惊呼，明眼人都已看出，楚真施展的乃是一段武技。
这百臂拳虽只是一段武技，但若能修炼到大成地步，却也非常强力。
同层次中，若没有相应的大成武技抗衡，必然不敌，所以人们都知道，楚枫已必败无疑。
楚月眉头紧皱，悄悄的向前跨出两步，想防止楚真暗下毒手。
“楚月，观战莫出手，这个规矩你不会不知道吧。”
可就在这时，一个声音却在耳边响起，回头观望，楚成正笑眯眯的盯着楚月。
楚月暗叫不好，她想不到这楚成会如此卑鄙，竟暗中盯着她。
而越是如此，便越代表，他们兄弟俩，不会轻易的放过楚枫，这让她更加担心起来。
“唰唰唰”
漫天的拳影几乎遮挡住了楚枫的视线，正夹带着破风之音，向他暴掠而来。
楚枫能够感觉到，楚真的拳力非同小可，没有丝毫留手，可见他真的是下了杀心。
不过楚枫却丝毫不惧，而是站在原地，不闪不避，静候他的攻击到来。
“这楚枫傻了么？怎么不躲？”
“他倒是想躲，可他躲的开么？以他的实力估计还没反应过来呢。”
“那倒也是，他可是在外门待了五年的废物。”
人们见楚枫不躲，都以为楚枫是被楚真的威势吓傻了，脸上流露出幸灾乐祸的笑容。
可就在楚真逼近之际，楚枫大袖猛然一挥，一股强大的气息便自体内爆发开来。
那气息扑面袭过，顿时让楚真为之一愣，因为他竟在那气息之中，感到了杀气。
就在楚真一愣神的功夫，楚枫猛然一掌击出，速度之快，还不待人们反应过来，已是轰在了楚真的胸口之上。

“砰”一掌击中，楚真顿时感觉气血翻腾，一股剧痛自胸口传来。
“唰唰唰”可他还来不及多想，楚枫已是数掌齐发，再次一一击中。
“呜哇”楚真大叫一声，双腿一软，竟直接跪在了楚枫的面前，而后无力的趴在了地上。
“这.....”
这一幕，看的人们目瞪口呆，因为他们无论如何也想不到，楚枫会有这样的爆发力
可他们更不知道，这还是楚枫留手的后果，如若不然他只需一掌，便可以将楚真活活打死。
“你是灵武四重？”这时楚威开口了，他一双眼睛紧紧的盯着楚枫，充满了震惊。
“什么？灵武四重？”
而楚威此话一出，人们也终于反应过来，可以不用武技，将灵武三重击败，这的确需要灵武四重的实力。
可是，当灵武四重这个词汇，与楚枫联系到一起时，人们却又感到不可思议，难以接受。
别说他们，就连楚月也是眼睛瞪的溜圆，小嘴微微的张起，脸上布满了吃惊。
楚枫并未理会众人，而是径直的走到桌子前，将三株仙灵草收了起来，而后便向门口走去。
“你给我站住，家人切磋，你竟下如此重手，你究竟是何居心？”可就在这时，一声厉喝猛然响起。
定目望去，楚成已是将楚真搀起，只不过楚成的脸上却布满怒色，弟弟被人打的如此之惨，这让他无法隐忍。
“怎么？这个时候想起我是楚家人了？先前你好像不是这么说的吧？”楚枫淡然一笑，而后道：“何况你也说了，拳脚无眼，若谁被打伤了，可别埋怨，你现在这是什么情况？当真输不起？”
“放屁，我会输不起？明明是你故意下狠手。”楚真咬着牙忍着痛，大声斥责道。
身为当事人，他很清楚，楚枫那一掌已经将他击败，可是楚枫却又连续数掌轰在他的身上，明显是故意为之，有意让他难堪。
而听他这么一说，楚枫又笑了：“我楚枫刚刚迈入灵武四重，对自身实力不是很了解。”
“而先前你的武技那般强势，我自然不敢轻敌，所以便全力应对。”
“谁曾想你竟是一只纸老虎，弱到不堪一击，枉我高看了你。”

“你....”听楚枫这样一说，楚真脸色煞白，腹内血气翻腾，气的他差点当场去世。
被众人眼中的一个废物击败不说，如今还被当众侮辱，实在让他难以承受。
可是，任凭他再不甘心，却也无话可说，因为刚才的规矩，的确是他兄弟二人立的。
“楚枫，你不要太狂妄，有种你和我交手”就在这时，另一位楚家人站了出来。
“喔？你也想和我切磋?可以，以仙灵草做赌注，敢么？”楚枫对着那人伸了伸手。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s quick channel for copyright complaints. “A piece of martial arts, the Hundred-Arm Fist, has been practiced to a great degree!”
There were exclamations in the hall, and anyone with a discerning eye could see that Chu Zhen was performing a martial arts skill.
Although this Hundred Arm Fist is only a martial art, if it can be practiced to a great level, it will be very powerful.
At the same level, if you don't have the corresponding great martial arts to compete, you will definitely be defeated, so everyone knows that Chu Feng is bound to lose.
Chu Yue frowned and quietly took two steps forward, hoping to prevent Chu Zhen from plotting a poisonous move.
"Chu Yue, don't make any moves while watching the battle. You don't know this rule, right?"
But at this moment, a voice sounded in his ears. Looking back, Chu Cheng was staring at Chu Yue with a smile.
Chu Yue secretly screamed, she didn't expect that Chu Cheng would be so despicable and would secretly stare at her.
The more this happened, the more it meant that the two brothers would not let Chu Feng go easily, which made her even more worried.
"Swish, swish, swish"
The fist shadows all over the sky almost blocked Chu Feng's sight, and they were rushing towards him with the sound of breaking wind.
Chu Feng could feel that Chu Zhen's punching power was extraordinary and he did not hold back at all, which showed that he really had murderous intentions.
However, Chu Feng was not afraid at all, but stood on the spot, waiting for his attack to arrive without dodge.
"Is this Chu Feng stupid? Why don't you hide?"
"He wants to hide, but can he? With his strength, he probably hasn't reacted yet."
"That's true, he is a loser who has been at the outer gate for five years."
Seeing that Chu Feng did not hide, people thought that Chu Feng was frightened by Chu Zhen's power, and a gloating smile appeared on his face.
But just as Chu Zhen was approaching, Chu Feng suddenly waved his sleeve, and a powerful aura burst out from his body.
The breath hit his face, and Chu Zhen was immediately stunned, because he actually felt murderous intent in that breath.
Just when Chu Zhen was stunned, Chu Feng suddenly struck out with a palm. The speed was so fast that before anyone could react, it hit Chu Zhen's chest.
"Bang" hit by the palm, Chu Zhen suddenly felt his blood boiling, and a sharp pain came from his chest.
"Swish, swish, swish," but before he had time to think too much, Chu Feng fired several palms together, hitting them one by one again.
"Wow!" Chu Zhen shouted, his legs softened, and he knelt directly in front of Chu Feng, and then lay weakly on the ground.
"This..."
The people watching this scene were stunned because they never imagined that Chu Feng would have such explosive power.
But they didn't even know that this was the result of Chu Feng's keeping his hands. Otherwise, he could beat Chu Zhen to death with just one palm.
"Are you at the fourth level of Lingwu?" Chu Wei spoke at this time. His eyes stared at Chu Feng tightly, full of shock.
"What? The fourth level of Lingwu?"
As soon as Chu Wei said these words, people finally realized that it was possible to defeat the third level Lingwu without martial arts. This indeed required the strength of the fourth level Lingwu.
However, when the term "fourth level of spiritual martial arts" was associated with Chu Feng, people found it unbelievable and found it difficult to accept it.
Not to mention them, even Chu Yue's eyes widened, her mouth opened slightly, and her face was full of surprise.
Chu Feng ignored everyone, but walked straight to the table, collected the three fairy grasses, and then walked towards the door.
"Stop here, let's talk about it as a family. You actually hit me so hard. What's your intention?" But at this moment, a sharp shout suddenly sounded.
Looking closely, Chu Cheng had already lifted Chu Zhen up, but Chu Cheng's face was full of anger. His brother was beaten so badly that he couldn't bear it.
"What? Now you remember that I am from the Chu family? You didn't say that before, right?" Chu Feng smiled lightly, and then said: "Besides, you also said that fists and feet have no eyes. If anyone is injured, don't complain.What's your situation now? Really can't afford to lose? "
"Fart, I can't afford to lose? It was obvious that you were cruel on purpose. "Chu Zhen gritted his teeth and endured the pain, and scolded loudly.
As the person involved, he knew very well that Chu Feng's palm had already defeated him, but Chu Feng hit him with several consecutive palms. It was obviously intentional and intended to embarrass him.
When he heard what he said, Chu Feng smiled again: "I, Chu Feng, have just entered the fourth level of spiritual martial arts, and I don't know much about my own strength. "
"As your martial arts were so powerful before, I naturally didn't dare to underestimate the enemy, so I dealt with it with all my strength. "
"Who would have thought that you are actually a paper tiger, so weak that you are vulnerable to a blow. I am in vain for my high regard for you. "
"You..." After hearing what Chu Feng said, Chu Zhen's face turned pale, and the blood in his abdomen was boiling. He was so angry that he almost died on the spot.
Not only was he defeated by a loser in the eyes of everyone, but now he was also humiliated in public, which was really unbearable for him.
However, no matter how unwilling he was, he had nothing to say, because the rules just now were indeed established by his two brothers.
"Chu Feng, don't be too arrogant. If you have the guts, you can fight me." At this moment, another Chu family member stood up.
"Oh? You also want to compete with me? Yes, you can make a bet with fairy grass. Do you dare? "Chu Feng stretched out his hand towards that person.
